images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production transparent environment sprite atlas for a hand-painted medieval fantasy isometric RPG, 2048 x 2048 square image.
Primary request: A carefully spaced 4 by 4 grid of SIXTEEN isolated high-detail game environment cutout sprites. Every cell exactly one isolated asset, same camera angle, no text, no cell borders. Genuine transparent alpha background, no opaque ground patches. Painted craftsmanship matching warm parchment-and-oil fantasy game art: visible wood grain, individually painted stones, subdued natural greens, honey lantern light, muted slate roofs. Crisp edges and readable silhouettes, not vector icons and not 3D renders. Camera: fixed orthographic three-quarter view from above about 40 degrees, visible front and right side, consistent upper-left light. Each object fully inside its own equal square cell with generous transparent padding, bottommost ground contact about 92% down its cell. Arrange row-major strictly:
Row 1: (1) broadleaf oak tree with textured trunk, (2) pale white-bark birch tree with slender green canopy, (3) dark green conifer/pine tree, (4) cluster of three grey granite boulders.
Row 2: (5) medieval half-timber cottage/inn with weathered slate roof and wooden door, (6) squat grey-stone square watchtower with arched door, (7) tan canvas expedition tent with wooden poles, (8) ruined stone arch and broken masonry.
Row 3: (9) short wooden fence/palisade section, (10) low rough-stone wall section, (11) two wooden crates and a coopered barrel group, (12) closed weathered iron-banded treasure chest.
Row 4: (13) simple wooden table with bench and two stools, (14) small wooden bookcase/shelf with books and pottery, (15) wooden direction signpost and small hanging lantern, (16) smith's stone forge with dark anvil, faint warm coals.
Constraints: Keep all sixteen silhouettes separated in their own grid cells. Exactly four columns and four rows. No characters, people, UI, lettering, numbers, logos, watermarks, backgrounds, checkerboards, scenic compositions, floor tile squares, dramatic cast shadows outside the objects. The alpha channel must make the entire surrounding background transparent. Each asset must be rich enough for a close mobile view and ready to crop by atlas UV.
